findings.description: The cycle guard (the `seen` set of visited exception ids) was removed from the `__cause__` chain walk, so the loop `while exc is not None` can now run forever on a circular cause chain.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an exception chain with a cycle, e.g. `a.__cause__ = b; b.__cause__ = a`, where no exception in the chain matches `exception_cause_types`. Mechanism: `exc = exc.__cause__` keeps alternating between `a` and `b` and never reaches None, and the removed `seen` check was the only thing that stopped it. Impact: the retry predicate hangs in an infinite loop instead of returning False.
